Mortise Deadlatch, Adams Rite 4512-35-101-628

Commercial aluminum frame store front door mortise Deadlatch body. Deadlatches offer flexibility of traffic control during and after business hours. A reverse turn of the key while bolt is held retracted retains the bolt, to allow twoway traffic for stores, hospitals, banks and other commercial buildings which require free entrance at certain times and exit-only at other times.

Specifications: for Adams Rite 4512-35-101-628

  • Backset: 1-1/8"
  • Handed, Field Reversible
  • Face plate: 1" width x 6-7/8" Length - Aluminum
  • Case Dimensions: 7/8" width x 6" Lenth, Depth specific to backset (1.63" - 1.78").
  • Latchbolt: 1/2" width x 1.0" length x 1/2" Throw
